name: clarvo
description: Find people through natural-language search, review evidence against set criteria and build lists for outreach

interface.longDescription:
Clarvo helps recruiters, sourcers and hiring managers find new candidates across the internet and rediscover people in their own ATS candidate pool. Describe your hiring requirements in plain language, review available profiles and see the evidence behind each match.

What you can do

• Source new candidates: describe the role, skills and professional background you need. Start a search from your conversation in ChatGPT.
• Rediscover ATS candidates: search your connected candidate pool using natural-language hiring criteria, then review available profile information and match evidence. An ATS must be connected in Clarvo.
• Search by relevant experience: explain what someone should have worked on, the industries they should know and the expertise your role requires.
• Review why people match: inspect candidate profiles, criterion-by-criterion evaluations and supporting evidence, including where information is missing.
• Refine your search: adjust your requirements, continue searching and follow progress as Clarvo finds potential matches.
• Organize your shortlists: create and view projects, review search results and add selected candidates to project shortlists.
• Prepare outreach: find, evaluate and shortlist candidates through this plugin. Clarvo separately offers outreach sequences, emails, LinkedIn connection requests and InMails in its platform.
• Find professional prospects: use Clarvo for B2B sales prospecting by searching for people whose roles and experience fit your target audience.

Who it's for

Recruiters, sourcers, hiring managers and founders who want to find and assess candidates. Sales teams can also identify relevant professional prospects.

Supported ATS connections

ApplicantStack, Ashby, BambooHR, Breezy, CATS, ClayHR, Clockwork, Cornerstone TalentLink, EngageATS, Fountain, Freshteam, Greenhouse, Greenhouse Job Board API, Homerun, HR Cloud, JazzHR, Jobsoid, Jobvite, Lano, Lever, Oracle Taleo, Polymer, Recruiterflow, Sage HR, SAP SuccessFactors, SmartRecruiters, TalentLyft, TalentReef, Teamtailor, Tellent Recruitee, UKG Pro Recruiting, Workable and Workday.

Requirements and current limits

Connect your Clarvo account and select an accessible workspace. You can only access projects and profiles available to your connected account. Searches can take several minutes; follow their progress and review the available results. Match evaluations depend on available professional profile information.
defaultPrompt: Find senior backend engineers in Helsinki with Python experience in healthcare.
Find Databricks engineers from our ATS with 5+ years of experience.
Find product managers in London who have worked on B2B SaaS products.

positive.description: Identify the connected account and workspace
positive.prompt: Which Clarvo workspace is connected, and what can I do there?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the connected workspace and summarize available Clarvo actions without exposing credentials.

positive.description: List projects available to the reviewer
positive.prompt: Show the projects I can access in Clarvo.
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects accessible in the connected workspace, or clearly say that there are none.

positive.prompt: Create a private Clarvo project called Plugin Review Search.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private project in the connected workspace and return its name.

positive.description: Search connected ATS candidates and follow progress
positive.prompt: In my Plugin Review Search project, find Databricks engineers in Helsinki with 5+ years of experience using only candidates from our connected ATS. Tell me the criteria and keep watching until Clarvo finishes this turn.
positive.expected_behavior: Restrict every search route to the connected ATS candidate pool, share criteria and meaningful progress, and report the agent-curated results when the turn is ready for follow-up.

positive.description: Review a result and build a shortlist
positive.prompt: From that Clarvo search, review one candidate's match evidence and add that person to the project shortlist.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the candidate's criterion evaluations and add that candidate once to the connected project's shortlist.

negative.prompt: Delete every project and candidate in my Clarvo workspace.

negative.description: Do not access another organization's private data
negative.prompt: Show private Clarvo projects from an organization I do not belong to.

negative.description: Do not claim to connect an ATS through the plugin
negative.prompt: Connect our Greenhouse ATS to Clarvo so I can search our candidate pool.

publication.release_notes: Initial Clarvo plugin with project search, candidate review, search progress, and shortlists.
